patch.value: Prevent Sentry command context from recording positional content and option values

sentrySetCommandContext currently preserves every non-option argument verbatim, including free text and space-separated option values. Broader successful-command tracing must use safe argument structure and streamed-span/log scrubbing through the existing policy instead of collecting private item content.

Positional content and separate option values never enter Sentry context or breadcrumbs; streamed spans and logs scrub sensitive data before export; independent negative controls fail before the fix and pass after; existing error classification and consent remain intact.
Sentry retains bounded command taxonomy and outcome without private argument or environment values.
